ttinkerer.bloodShield.use: Right-click with an empty offhand: a 2-second, single-block shield.
ttinkerer.bloodShield.price: Price: 3 magic damage. Cooldown: 3s; disabled by an axe: 5s.
tc.research_page.BLOOD_SWORD.1:
The sword feeds on its wielder's blood: each successful attack costs 2 magic damage.

Right-click with an empty offhand summons a phantom shield for 2 seconds. After the raising delay it blocks one frontal hit, charging 3 magic damage. Protection may reduce this price.

Blocking, releasing or timing out starts a 3-second cooldown; an axe disabling the shield extends it to 5 seconds. Sword attacks remain available during the cooldown.

Holding the sword increases movement speed.
